subject: Implement AMC webhook listener with HMAC verify, dedupe, and fast-ACK
description:
Build `capo/transport/amc_listener.py` — FastAPI app exposing `POST /amc/webhook` bound to `127.0.0.1:8090` per §5.2 and §7.4.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] HMAC verification BEFORE parsing or logging the body: compute `sha256=<hex>` over raw body using `AMC_WEBHOOK_SECRET`; compare with `hmac.compare_digest` against `X-AMC-Signature`. Reject `401` on mismatch.
- [ ] Fast-ACK: respond `204` within < 1s P99 after signature + dedupe; agent work happens in dispatcher worker, not handler.
- [ ] Dedupe LRU keyed by `X-AMC-Delivery-Id` covering at least 15 minutes of retries; duplicates return `204` without enqueue.
- [ ] Listener parses request body as `AMCInboundEnvelope` (Pydantic `extra="allow"`) and enqueues to dispatcher.
- [ ] `401` body matches §7.4: `{ "error": { "code": "BAD_SIGNATURE", "message": "X-AMC-Signature does not match body HMAC" } }`.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Signature mismatch: `401`, no body parsed, log signature-fail metric.
- [ ] Duplicate delivery: `204`, no enqueue, log dedupe-hit metric.
- [ ] Long-running turn (>60s): handler already 204'd at ack time; worker handles in background.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Worker exception on enqueue must not block the handler; failures are logged and the request still returns `204` (idempotent retries are safe).

_Performance:_
- [ ] Webhook handler ACK P99 < 1s (synthetic 1000 reqs at 5 rps test).

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: HMAC verify accepts correct signature, rejects bad signature
• Unit: dedupe LRU returns 204 on repeat delivery-id within window
• Integration: 1000 synthetic signed webhooks at 5 rps; assert P99 < 1s ACK
• Integration: signature mismatch never reaches dispatcher

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.2, 6.1, 7.4, 9.1
